This is the sole authored provider layout plan-field table, distinct from a workspace or launch plan. Compatibility modes and operator MCP mirrors preserve existing adapter projections without a second placement table. Older layout exports are historical evidence.

Rows select provider, layer, transport and optional variant. Empty transport means the layer default; more specific transport and variant rows override it. Paths are relative to logical roots supplied by the host. Native documents compose only under an explicit serializer owner. Credential destinations are link effects and never managed file writes. Unsupported capabilities refuse required requests or name optional omissions. See [package documentation](../plan/doc.go) for intended output changes and support boundaries.
